## Executive Summary
Robiul Hasan is an L2 Infrastructure & Systems Support Engineer and Service Desk Co-Leader managing enterprise operations, zero-trust endpoint security, and autonomous cloud systems. He combines hands-on sysadmin expertise across 2,500+ endpoints and 1,100+ Bitdefender EDR assets with modern agentic AI engineering.

## Key Projects
### Products built at Thrive IT Solutions
- **TimeBuddy** (https://timebuddy.orderbuddy.pro/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/timebuddy/): Multi-tenant workforce time tracking and attendance SaaS with a Next.js dashboard, Express/Prisma API, and a native Windows Win32 desktop agent. No keystroke logging or webcam capture.
- **OrderBuddy** (https://orderbuddy.pro/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/orderbuddy/): Multi-tenant courier dispatch SaaS for e-commerce merchants, unifying Pathao, RedX and more behind one dashboard, with a BullMQ/Redis background worker and AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials.
- **LedgerBuddy** (https://ledgerbuddy.thriveitbd.com/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/ledgerbuddy/): Offline-first business ledger, inventory and POS app built with Flutter and Supabase sync. Published on Microsoft Store (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NSR6DN33V8T) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thriveitbd.ledgerbuddy).
- **Equa** (https://equa.thriveitbd.com/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/equa/): Offline-first, double-entry personal finance ledger built with Flutter, Riverpod and Drift. Published on Microsoft Store (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM1MTHMCSGK).

### Personal projects
- **NextVector** (https://nextvector.rhasan.online/): Independent digital intelligence publication delivering daily technology & AI news reporting, "The Morning Vector" newsletter, and an integrated, continuously expanding registry of 135+ frontier AI models and LMSYS Arena Elo benchmarks.
- **Hermes AI Ambassador** (https://rhasan.online/projects/hermes/): Autonomous portfolio concierge and intelligent technical ambassador built with Groq Llama-3.3-70B inference, client-side cryptographic hashing, and dual-layer caching.
- **MediScribe Live** (https://mediscribe.rhasan.online/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/mediscribe-live/): Hackathon build for the AssemblyAI Voice Agent Hackathon (lablab.ai, September 2026). Voice-first ER assistant: bedside voice triage with the AssemblyAI Voice Agent API and live tool calls, an ambient medical scribe on AssemblyAI Realtime STT (Universal-3.5 Pro, medical-v1), and source-linked SOAP notes via the AssemblyAI LLM Gateway with clinician sign-off and HL7 FHIR R4 export. Source: https://github.com/Daddy-Ousen/mediscribe-live
- **Innworld RPG** (https://daddy-ousen.github.io/innworld-rpg/ · case study https://rhasan.online/projects/innworld-rpg/): Free, non-commercial fan RPG set in "The Wandering Inn" by pirateaba, built in Godot 4.7 and GDScript. Headless deterministic simulation core (all rules in game/core/, one GameState, one seeded RNG, versioned JSON saves with migrations); Books 1–6 encoded as validated JSON data (898 canon events, 261 characters, 103 places, 38 maps) so canon is the default timeline the player can bend; XCOM-style turn-based combat on the map grid; classes and Skills earned by behaviour rather than chosen from a menu. Ships as a WebAssembly browser build plus Windows and Linux downloads (v0.1.1-alpha). Tested with 147 GUT scripts (~1,400 tests), 102 Python tool tests and a JSON data validator. Source: https://github.com/Daddy-Ousen/innworld-rpg
- **LedgerBuddy AI** (https://rhasan.online/projects/ledgerbuddy-ai/): Hackathon build for AMD Developer Hackathon: ACT II (lablab.ai). Multi-agent financial intelligence and double-entry bookkeeping assistant with rule-based heuristics, dynamic confidence scoring, and automated reconciliations.
- **Oggro Tech Enterprise** (https://rhasan.online/projects/oggro-tech/): Enterprise corporate identity and digital transformation platform with dynamic client service portals and hardened infrastructure.

## Core Competencies
- **Cloud & Systems:** Microsoft 365 Administration, Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM), Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, PowerShell Scripting, macOS/Jamf Pro, Windows Server.
- **Security & BCDR:** Bitdefender GravityZone EDR, Incident Containment, Zero-Trust Policies, Datto SIRIS/ALTO BCDR, Acronis Cyber Protect, Disaster Recovery Drills.
- **AI Engineering & Automation:** AI Automation & Agentic Workflows, AI Deployment & Optimization (latency, token cost, caching, rate limiting), Prompt Engineering & Structured Output, AI/LLM API Integration & Configuration.
- **Software Engineering:** Python, TypeScript, Astro, React, Tailwind CSS, Fastify/Node.js, Flutter, Cloud Deployment & CI/CD (Vercel, Render, Docker), Structured JSON-LD.
